text:
Which description of the structure of an atom is correct?
A
negatively charged electrons surrounding an uncharged nucleus
B
negatively charged electrons surrounding a positively charged nucleus
C
positively charged electrons surrounding an uncharged nucleus
D
positively charged electrons surrounding a negatively charged nucleus

options.label: A
options.text: negatively charged electrons surrounding an uncharged nucleus

options.label: B
options.text: negatively charged electrons surrounding a positively charged nucleus

options.label: C
options.text: positively charged electrons surrounding an uncharged nucleus

options.label: D
options.text: positively charged electrons surrounding a negatively charged nucleus
